**Date:** January 27th, 2026
**Place:** Jon Lilletuns vei 9, C2 042
**Meeting start:** 16.23
agenda:
* Approval of the notice - Approved without objections * Approval of the agenda - Approved without objections * Protocol - Chair: Jakob - Minute taker: Morten - Minute signers: Brage and Artis - Anonymous voting and ⅔ majority on bylaws approved - No objections or other proposals * Annual report - Jakob talked about the period with the number of events - Benjamin presented the finances and the 2025 budget year (last year) - No objections * Incoming items * Notice for the General Assembly. - Rationale: make sure there's enough information, time and agenda before the general assembly - Change/wording: > The general assembly shall be announced to the members no later than two (2) weeks before the meeting is held. The deadline for submitting items to the general assembly is no later than one (1) week before the meeting. The complete agenda, as well as all submitted proposals and any case documents, shall be made available to the members no later than one (1) week before the general assembly. - **49 for** and **0 against** (of 53) - Decision: **Unanimously approved** * AI interest group - Rationale: plan an AI competition, run AI projects - Change/wording: > **§ 4-2-1**
> The main board consists of 10 members: leader, deputy leader, finance manager, PR manager, BetaLAN leader, Eventkom leader, Bedkom leader, (BetaAI leader,) BetaDEV leader and BetaSEC leader. > **§ 6-1**
> Beta has (three) interest groups: (BetaAI,) BetaDEV and BetaSEC. - **43 for** and 5 **against** - Decision: **approved**, with a provision that the interest group can name itself * Coffee machine - The board can look into it * BetaDEV advertising - Input from the floor: bounty board, the projects, leaderboard w/ point system, achievements, learning, CV, hall of fame, w/ pin/sticker as prize - Input from the floor: event «join a project», «pitch», «active projects» between dev, sec and ai * Code competition - Good interest in this - From the floor: external companies, for example sponsors - From the floor: national championship in programming * Cozier events that also fit outside gaming and development - *From the floor*: - The event committee's responsibility - Good plan - There might be willingness to pay an entry fee for something like a ski weekend - Could also have smaller and simpler events - Could collaborate with the other student associations. - Own career day? * Company presentations at apotekergården - Initiative for better company presentations * Pizza from Domino's - Might be possible - Ask about a discount * Any other business * Board games? TADA/BETA collaboration * Include deputy leaders of committees and interest groups in the start-up period. Is possible. * Honorary member - William nominated by the board - **William Skauge** is **unanimously approved** as **honorary member** with a whopping 45 for! * Intro to board positions presentation held * Election of the board - Leader: Jakob - Deputy leader: Morten - Finance: Andreas Beitnes - BetaDev: Ingeborg - BetaSec: Magnus J - BetaML: Jørgen - BetaLAN: Håvard - PR: Brage - Event committee: Magnus Tytlandsvik - Business committee: Mats * Pizza and drinks * Closing
